essence: The ritual setup requires a grain altar and a five-layered bed with specified materials.
The guru should resolve upon and establish the human seat with the praṇava.
The guru must install the image on the seat according to the previously stated procedure.
The image with the bound protective thread should be placed upon the bed.
The principal pot should be placed in the northern part near the head.
